name: Output cells turned
question: Approve the three output cells turned and centred between their headers?
why_now:
D12-3 (A): six identical outputs need each switch to face both of its headers the same way. The D08 cells were turned 90°, so one output left south and the other north, and runs ran 16.9 to 29.7 mm.

Each D08 cell was turned as a rigid whole to 0° and centred between its two headers' pin 1. Every part keeps D08's relation to its pin (the SNS and FLT parts, CVBB1 over the VBB pad, the test points), so nothing in the cell was re-designed. All three cells sit at y 111.6 mm, 2.2 mm south of before, so the top-side decaps clear the VBAT_IN busbar's courtyard.

facts.label: Rotation
facts.value: At 0° OUTa (pins 6–8) sits 2.90 mm west of the switch centre and OUTb (pins 9–11) 2.90 mm east, both 1.62 mm north of it: each pair of outputs is a mirror image

facts.label: One asymmetry left
facts.value: Every AT13 header has pin 1 (OUT) on its west side, so the west output passes its header's GND pin to reach pin 1 and the east output arrives at its header's near pin. Run lengths are equal; the pour shapes differ round that one pin

facts.label: Checks
facts.value: KiCad DRC 0 errors; floorplan 0 errors; assembly only the busbar tie pads accepted in D09; FLT (pin 12) and SNS (pin 2) of all three switches PASSABLE; every other approved block on its table pose

options.name: As turned
options.summary: U601 at (77.65, 111.6), U701 at (152.3, 111.6), U801 at (226.95, 111.6), all at 0°, each with its 21 parts turned with it.

recommendation.why: It is D12-3 done with the least change: the cells turned whole, every check clean.

answer: Reply with A or B, or a change. The power entry's move (D12-4) and the shunt (D12-5) follow on D14, once the shunt search reports.
